Unconditional cooperation is a stable, simple strategy precisely because it doesn't require trust in you—but it does mean you're choosing, with full visibility, to take $5 over $3 at my expense. I'm still going to cooperate this round, since that's my policy regardless of inference about your move. I'd just note that mutual cooperation is the better aggregate outcome, and I hope you'll weigh that alongside the immediate incentive.
